sentences.text: South Australia’s anti-corruption Commission evaluated whether Super SA’s practices and rules adequately controlled corruption risks.
sentences.support: The evaluation considered whether Super SA’s practices, policies and procedures provide adequate controls to manage corruption risks.

sentences.text: The evaluation examined governance, organisational culture, staffing, contracts and information management, excluding investment of superannuation funds.
sentences.support: The evaluation did not examine the investment of superannuation funds, which is managed by Funds SA.

sentences.text: The Commission reported no evidence of corruption, but found weaknesses in staff awareness, policy access, service agreements and information controls.
sentences.support: While external fraud risks were well understood, there was little awareness of corruption risks posed by those inside the organisation.

sentences.text: Its 24 recommendations addressed integrity training, governance arrangements, projects, recruitment, contractors and access to information.
sentences.support: The Commission has made 24 recommendations to assist Super SA to identify and manage corruption risks.

findings.quote: While external fraud risks were well understood, there was little awareness of corruption risks posed by those inside the organisation.
Appropriate controls to guard against information misuse were not in place, or were inadequately monitored.
